finding.title: Convert TutorPinResult switches in gate/setup screens from statements to switch expressions per EH-6
finding.why: coding-standards.md EH-6 states closed variant sets must be modeled as sealed + 'switch over it with switch expressions; never add a default:/_ arm.' Both files use switch STATEMENTS (case Pattern: followed by statement blocks) over the sealed TutorPinResult, not the mandated expression form (contrast with tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart's `child: switch (_step) { ... => ..., }`, which does it correctly). Functionally harmless today — Dart's exhaustiveness checker covers statement-form switches too — but it's a textual violation of an explicitly documented, partially-enforced standard, and inconsistent with the sibling file in the same feature.
finding.recommendation: Rewrite both switches as switch expressions (`TutorPinSuccess() => widget.onPinVerified(), ...`), matching tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart's style.
acceptance_criteria: both switches use the `Pattern => ...,` expression form with no default/_ arm
flutter analyze remains clean and existing gate/setup widget tests pass unchanged

finding.title: Replace source-text-grep assertions with real widget tests in t3_readonly_surfaces_gating_test.dart and r3_shell_revocation_exit_test.dart
finding.why: These tests call File(...).readAsStringSync() and assert expect(src, contains('token')) against the raw source text of 5 other-feature screens (app_shell.dart, settings_screen.dart, learning_screen.dart, dashboard_body.dart, text_display_screen.dart). A string search passes whenever the token appears anywhere in the file — in a comment, on an inverted condition, or on unreachable code. Concretely: if a future edit flips the Add Track CTA gate to `!canEditStages`, moves the `if (!isTutoredSession)` guard so UserProfileHeaderCard (the tutor's own sign-out/delete-account surface) renders during a tutored session again (this already shipped once, per the file's own 'BUG 2' comment), or removes the MarkLiveCompletionUseCase call from the live-mark button's onPressed while leaving the string 'MarkLiveCompletionUseCase' in an unrelated comment, every one of these 24 test blocks (23 in t3 across AC1-AC5 plus TUT-04, 1 block/3 assertions in r3's self-labelled 'Structural tests (source-level)' group) keeps passing. Repo-wide grep confirms no other test file references isTutorElevated/isTutoredSession for these screens, so this is the SOLE regression coverage for tutor-mode UI gating outside the tutoring feature. r3's other 3 tests in the same file are genuine provider-level regression tests and are not affected by this finding.
finding.recommendation: Convert each assertion to a widget test that pumps the real screen with canEditStages/isTutoredSession toggled via provider overrides and asserts the CTA/surface is actually present or absent in the render tree — the pattern r3's own first 3 tests and every other l1 test in this batch already use correctly. Delete r3's redundant structural block once covered, or replace it with a widget-level assertion.
acceptance_criteria: Each AC1-AC5 group in t3_readonly_surfaces_gating_test.dart is a testWidgets pumping the real screen and asserting on Finder/rendered output, not File.readAsStringSync() text
A regression test fails if the `if (!isTutoredSession)` guard is removed from UserProfileHeaderCard in settings_screen.dart (BUG 2 class)
A regression test fails if learning_screen.dart's Add Track CTA gate is inverted to `!canEditStages`

finding.title: Add TutoredWriteRouter coverage for the 4 always-pass-through methods in s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart

evidence.quote: // S1 — TutoredWriteRouter unit tests ... AC1..AC4 (no mention of pushSettings/pushLearningOrder/pushUiPreferencesSnapshot/deleteLearnerProfile)
//   deleteLearnerProfile (talmid's profile deletion is not a tutor right).

finding.why: The router's own comment says deleteLearnerProfile is deliberately excluded from tutor routing because talmid profile deletion is not a tutor right — a documented access-control decision. This 1003-line test file (tagged 'keystone') exhaustively covers the other 10 intercepted entity kinds across tutored/non-tutored/CF-failure branches, but grep confirms zero calls to pushSettings, pushLearningOrder, pushUiPreferencesSnapshot, or deleteLearnerProfile anywhere in the file (or anywhere else in test/features/tutoring). If a future edit accidentally applied the `if (sel == null) return _delegate.X(...)` interception pattern to deleteLearnerProfile with the condition backwards, a tutor could trigger deletion of the talmid's profile via a CF call and nothing in this suite would fail.
finding.recommendation: Add an 'always pass-through' group mirroring the existing tutored/non-tutored pattern: call each of the 4 methods via _tutored(record, delegate) and assert record.wasCalled is false and the matching delegate counter incremented.
acceptance_criteria: s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart asserts deleteLearnerProfile in tutored mode never invokes the CF invoker and always reaches the delegate
Same coverage added for pushSettings, pushLearningOrder, pushUiPreferencesSnapshot

finding.title: Verify TutoredMirrorWipeService fires on tutor resign/revoke in manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart and manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart

evidence.quote: testWidgets('confirming resignation calls ResignTutorGrantUseCase', ( ... verify(() => mockResignUseCase.call(...)).called(1);
testWidgets('confirming Revoke calls revokeTutorGrantUseCase with the grant', ( ... only verifies mockRevoke.call, no mirror/session assertion

finding.why: Both the tutor-side resign flow and the parent-side revoke flow fire-and-forget (unawaited) a local Drift mirror wipe plus an active-session exit() callback as an explicit fix (comment tag R4-M3) after the grant use case succeeds. This is the same class of stale-local-data bug this codebase already shipped once and wrote a dedicated regression test for elsewhere (iter10_outgoing_grants_stale_cache_test.dart, DG-TUT-STALE-01) — yet repo-wide grep for wipeMirrorForGrant/buildTutoredMirrorWipeServiceFromWidget in test/features/tutoring returns zero matches. Neither test file verifies the Drift mirror row is actually removed, or that activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider clears when the resigned/revoked grant is the active tutored session. A regression that silently drops the unawaited(...) call, or breaks the onWipe wiring, ships undetected.
finding.recommendation: Seed an in-memory Drift mirror row for the grant (reusing the inMemoryDb()/_seedActiveMirror pattern from r3_shell_revocation_exit_test.dart), confirm resign/revoke, then assert the mirror row is gone; add a case where the wiped grant is the active tutored selection and assert the provider clears.
acceptance_criteria: manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart asserts the Drift tutored-mirror row for a resigned grant is deleted after confirming resignation
manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart asserts the same for a revoked grant
Both cover the case where the wiped grant is the active tutored session and assert activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider becomes null

finding.title: Remove or implement the dead 'hardcoded string audit' test in invite_tutor_screen_l1_test.dart
finding.why: Uri.file(path).toString() never reads the filesystem — it only stringifies the path — so expect(src, isNotEmpty) is true for any non-empty path string regardless of what invite_tutor_screen.dart actually contains. The test's own comment admits it 'passes trivially.' A test named 'screen source contains no hardcoded English UI strings' that passes in CI creates false confidence that AX-2 is enforced for this file when it is not enforced at all — this is exactly the gap custom_lint's no_hardcoded_domain_term rule would otherwise catch if custom_lint were not currently broken (baselined separately).
finding.recommendation: Delete the test (the finding is already documented in the file's header comment) or make it real: read actual file contents via File(...).readAsStringSync() and assert against a regex for quoted English text outside l10n. calls.
acceptance_criteria: The test either asserts on real file contents via File(...).readAsStringSync() or is removed
No test in the file can pass independent of the file it claims to check
